extraction.name: CommonCatalog
extraction.description: A dataset of roughly 70 million open-licensed Creative-Commons (CC) images paired with high-quality synthetic captions generated using BLIP-2.
extraction.creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were re-scraped from Flickr based on IDs provided in the YFCC100M metadata, excluding images with non-derivative (ND) licenses.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Almost all CC images lack the captions necessary to train a high-quality T2I model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Flickr images based on IDs from the YFCC100M dataset metadata.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Used a pre-trained BLIP-2 model to produce high-quality, synthetic captions for the curated, open licensed CC images.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were center-cropped and resized to a maximum size of 512x512 pixels for captioning. At training time, images remained in their native resolution.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Captions were synthetically generated using the pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Synthetic captions showed reduced diversity of n-grams and unique trigrams compared to ground-truth captions, but exceeded them in CLIP Score.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Provides an alternative method of navigating copyright concerns in image generation by training only on open-licensed, Creative-Commons data.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The model underperformed in categories including faces, general photography, and paintings. The YFCC100M data is about a decade old and not as current as LAION-2B.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: we re-scraped these images from Flickr, based on the IDs provided in the YFCC100M metadata.

rai:dataCollectionMissingData.evidence: The first problem is data incompleteness: almost all CC images lack the captions necessary to train a high-quality T2I model.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We began with the YFCC100M dataset, which consists of 100 million CC-licensed images and multimedia files, as well as Flickr IDs linking to the original data

rai:dataImputationProtocol.evidence: We address the data incompleteness problem by using a pre-trained BLIP-2 model [34], which we use to produce high-quality, synthetic captions for a set of curated, open licensed CC images.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: we center-cropped and resized all of the images to a maximum size of 512x512 pixels. We perform these transformations because captioning images at native resolution would be very expensive. At training time of the diffusion model, all images remain in their native resolution.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: chose to use the pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model for synthesizing CommonCatalog’s captions [34].

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: the CLIP Score for synthetic captions exceeded that of ground-truth captions... We also observed reduced diversity of n-grams in our synthetic captions... This effect can be visualized through the decrease in unique trigrams.
